meta.name: board-prep
meta.description: Board meeting preparation for the adversarial scenario, not the friendly one. Forces numbers-cold mastery, anticipates hard questions, builds a narrative that acknowledges weakness without losing the room. Use when preparing for a board meeting, an investor update, fundraising presentation, or any high-stakes adversarial review where every number must live in your head not just on a slide.

copy.tagline: 准备董事会汇报材料，预判尖锐提问
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在高压力场景下向董事会或投资人做数据汇报
copy.tagline_en: Prepare board materials and anticipate tough questions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to present data to a board or investors under high pressure

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你准备对抗性董事会会议。它会要求你熟记所有关键数字，预测最难的问题，并构建一个承认弱点但不失掌控的叙事。
howto.when: 当你准备董事会会议、投资人更新、融资演示或任何高风险的对抗性审查时触发。

say.text: 帮我准备下周三的董事会，重点是收入未达标的部分。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成数字记忆、问题预测和叙事构建。

say.text: 模拟一下最难对付的董事可能问的问题。
say.note: Claude 会生成对抗性问题列表供你练习。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you prepare for adversarial board meetings. It forces you to memorize key numbers cold, anticipate the hardest questions, and build a narrative that acknowledges weakness without losing the room.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are preparing for a board meeting, investor update, fundraising presentation, or any high-stakes adversarial review.

say_en.text: Help me prepare for next Wednesday's board meeting, focusing on the revenue miss.
Simulate the toughest director's possible questions.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a list of adversarial questions for you to practice.
